title-proc.eng: MARKET SURVEY Ammonia (NH3) Gas Analyzer for Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke)

description-proc.eng: With this market survey/ prior information notice Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke) surveys the market and requests information from suppliers concerning the procurement of Ammonia (NH3) Analyzer. Luke is searching for an Ammonia (NH3) Analyzer that can be attached to an existing Eddy-Covariance measurement station located in an agriculture environment. Analyzer must function outdoors and provide a scientific accuracy and robustness for long-term environmental monitoring. The procurement entity invites the interested suppliers to participate in a market dialogue by sending their expression of interest and contact details (contact person, e-mail address) by e-mail to kirjaamo@luke.fi and copy to hankintatuki@luke.fi preferably by 9th of March 2026 at the latest. The e-mail should be titled/identified with a mark "Market Survey LUKE/377/02.10.01.00.05/2026, Ammonia Analyzer". The interested suppliers are also kindly asked in their e-mail to provide answers to the following questions: - Ammonia (NH3) is a reactive and sticky substance and adsorbs to the surfaces. How is this considered in the technical design and features of the device you supply? - Long-term environmental monitoring requires that the used measurement devices are usable under varying weather and are not overly sensitive to e.g. varying temperature. How is this considered in the technical design of the device you supply? - Analyzer must have a minimum sampling frequency of 10 Hz. What are the measurements ranges, accuracy/precision ranges and response time of the device at this sampling frequency you can supply? - Are there peer-viewed scientifical publications with your supplied device where it has been used for Eddy-Covariance flux measurements? If yes, please provide references. - What is the warranty time for your device? - What is the delivery time for your device? - What kind of maintenance or calibration does your device need and at what frequency? - Can you provide technical product sheets and user manual for your device? The procurement entity may also send further questions and/or draft procurement documents to interest suppliers for comments by email. The schedules presented and other information presented in this notice, such as the planned course of the market dialogue, are preliminary information that may change as the preparation progresses. This market consultation and the information provided in it do not bind or oblige the parties to anything, and do not oblige the procurement entity to make a purchase. All information provided is treated as confidential. Participants of the market consultation are not compensated for participating in the market dialogue, nor for the costs incurred by participating. Participating in the market consultation shall not prevent the supplier from participating in the actual tender, and responding to the market consultation does not affect the supplier's position in the actual tender. The actual call for tenders will be published through the electronic Hanki tender service during spring 2026.

title-proc.eng: 25/01837 LC-MS/MS (QQQ) - Stage 1

description-proc.eng: The Norwegian Institute of Marine Research shall procure a new LC-MS/MS (QQQ). In monitoring marine samples, fish feed and seafood, we routinely determine known PFAS, and other analyte groups such as pesticides and pharmaceuticals as well as positive substances such as vitamins, with LC-MS/MS. Our instruments and methods meet current testing requirements in connection with maximum limits for conformity assessment and content declaration for nutrients and vitamins. In order to meet the ever-increasing expectations to detect lower amounts of substances based on levels relevant to toxicological effects and the lack of data for risk assessments, there is a demand for both methodological improvements and the use of more sensitive instruments. LC-MS/MS is a technique under constant development that can currently detect and quantify very small amounts of various compounds in a sample. The instrument will be used for the determination of the most challenging PFAS compounds, in ultra-low amounts in complex matrices. The instrument will be used for both research analyses and testing in our ISO 17025 accredited laboratory. Our role as a supplier of research results, monitoring data and risk assessments to authorities will form the basis for our assessment of the specifications in the table below. This procurement will include an option for an instrument no. 2 which may be purchased later. This instrument may be used for e.g. fat-soluble vitamins which are currently analyzed with LC spectroscopy at the Institute of Marine Research as it is desirable to transfer such analysis methodology of e.g. fat-soluble vitamins and other nutrients to LC-MS/MS. title-proc.eng: Bainisteoir Beag - digital development

description-proc.eng: Kilkenny Recreation and Sports Partnership (KRSP) was established in 2004 following a successful bid to Sport Ireland. The key aims of the Local Sports Partnership is to increase participation in sport through coordination, ensuring that local resources are used to best effect. The KRSP vision for Kilkenny is an active vibrant community, vitalised by sports and recreation opportunities that are accessible to all. KRSP aims to work collaboratively with others to empower people and communities across Kilkenny to create an environment that supports lifelong participation in sports and active recreation for all. Full details can be found on our website www.krsp.ie BAINISTEOIR BEAG – BACKGROUND AND CONTEXT The Bainisteoir Beag (Young Leader) playground leader’s programme was developed by Kilkenny Recreation and Sports Partnership (KRSP) to support leadership, inclusion, and physical literacy among primary school pupils. The programme empowers pupils in fifth and sixth class (aged 10–13) to plan and deliver teacher-supervised inclusive activities for younger children (2ND and 3RD class) during playground and class sessions. The current iteration of the programme consists of a folder containing activity cards. To scale up the programme across Ireland it will be necessary to convert as many of these activities (in line with budget) to digital / animated platform (app or website). The Bainisteoir Beag programme includes: • 40 playground activities and games • 29 indoor exercises (for wet days, warm-ups, or energisers) • Colourful, child-friendly characters and activity cards with clear instructions • Guidance and leadership materials for pupils and teachers Each activity card includes: • An illustration of how the game looks • Required equipment • Key teaching points and safety considerations • Adaptation tips to make activities easier or harder • Interesting facts for some of the games The programme was successfully piloted in Kilkenny-area schools, with positive feedback from teachers and pupils. Following this, KRSP tendered for the development of one activity in a digital/animated format. This was then piloted to schools. KRSP monitored the delivery in one school. Extremely positive feedback was received from teachers and pupils. As a result, KRSP now intends to fully digitise and animate the programme by developing an accessible and engaging app or website to host the programme on. THE PROJECT OBJECTIVES KRSP wishes to select, procure and implement Bainisteoir Beag, a support programme that encourages pupil led inclusive activities in the Primary School playground. The aim of the programme is to enable pupils in fifth and sixth class (10 to 13 years old) to deliver teacher supervised inclusive activities to the pupils in younger classes. • Based on costs we aim to transfer as many of the 40 activities / games and 29 indoor exercises (for rainy days) from a folder / card-based system to an animated digital system. • The programme will be housed on an app / website which should make the programme easy to disseminate to Primary School throughout Ireland. • We aim to make this digital version of Bainisteoir Beag user friendly and ready for teachers to use in the classroom – without any need for KRSP to provide trained tutors to deliver the programme. • The app / website will enable teachers in Ireland to register, log in and deliver the programme in their own classroom in either English or Irish. • The technology, images and feel of the programme should be like what children are experiencing in other areas of their digital lives. The system must be designed to deliver an engaging, reliable and GDPR-compliant experience across all devices and networks. Primary users: Teachers in Primary Schools in Ireland in English or Irish; Pupil leaders aged 10-13.

title-proc.eng: External assistance with Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) of the Ukraine Transition Programme 2025 - 2028

description-proc.eng: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Royal Danish Embassy in Kyiv, has entered into a contract regarding assistance with Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) of the Ukraine Transition Programme 2025 - 2028. Since 2004, Denmark has supported Ukraine through development support for the Eastern neighbourhood region, the so-called Neighbourhood Programme. Following the Maidan revolution in Ukraine in 2014, there has been an increasing focus on supporting the country’s progress towards approaching the EU and the advancement of reforms within the areas of good governance, democracy, and human rights, as well as supporting growth, improved labour market conditions, and green energy transition. Ukraine has since February 2022 developed into the largest recipient of Danish development assistance. To provide a long-term strategic framework for the current and future support, Denmark has prepared a Ukraine Transition Programme (UTP) for the period July 2025 – June 2028. The support will cover existing as well as future reconstruction and reform efforts expected to be funded in the programme period, including continued efforts to assist Ukraine in combating corruption and strengthen the country’s anti-corruption institutions. The support under the UTP will be fully aligned with the new Country Strategic Framework for Denmark’s partnership with Ukraine July 2025 – June 2028. The Strategic Framework was approved in spring 2025, and has been developed in consultation and dialogue with Ukrainian partners. The Strategic Framework has guided the identification of support to UTP under the emerging focus areas of the strategy: • Focus area 1: Strengthening resilience and cohesion, and address the urgent needs of populations, including support for early recovery and transition. • Focus area 2: Energy security, green transition and just growth creation of jobs. • Focus area 3: Reforms and EU-accession: consolidating and development of democratic institutions and processes of democratic institutions and processes. The Department for European Neighbourhood (EUNABO) wishes to engage a MEAL Consultant to perform various tasks, such as the following and specified further in Appendix 1 (not exhaustive listing): • Refinement of result frameworks • Reviewing of annual narrative reports from implementing partners • Selected validation of information • Annual reports • Sharing lessons learned • Thematic and cross cutting reporting and deep dives • Completion reports • Financial monitoring The purpose of the Assignment is to enable the Royal Danish Embassy in Kyiv (RDE) and the Embassy Office in Mykolaiv (EOM) together with implementing partners to – if needed and relevant - adjust implementation/activities of projects/partners under the UTP. Moreover, the purpose of the Assignment is to contribute to a flexible and agile implementation and management of the projects/programmes under UTP, including risk management. The objective of the Assignment is to support the EUNABO, RDE and EOM in responding to its MEAL responsibilities including strengthening its monitoring and reporting as well as its adjustment of the risk-matrix of the UTP.
